agents.note: Sprint 62 (V0.29.16) COMPLETE 2/2 -- US-484-b DONE (passes:true), the SAFETY half of the split US-484. Repointed the DTC STOP tier + takeover off brand red onto SSOT --critical-red #D32F2F (tokens.css:69, Atlas gate 2026-07-26) and, per Spool 6d, built the four NON-COLOUR channels that actually carry STOP -- the hex is the 3rd reinforcement because #D32F2F vs brand red differ mainly in SATURATION, the eye's weakest discriminator at arm's length on the narrow-gamut OSOYOO. ch.1 AREA/MOTION/TEXT: takeover keeps base full-bleed inset:0, gains an 8px critical-red frame pulsing via @keyframes stop-alarm-pulse SCOPED TO [data-severity=stop] (motion must never imply a state that isn't real -- carousel spec 4), directive rendered white-on-critical-red at 22px vs the 15px base. ch.2: field is var(--bg) #000000 (one of the two near-blacks 6d permits -- deliberately did NOT invent a near-black token, that is the TD-065 group-(b) Atlas gate) + white copy; contrast COMPUTED IN THE TEST from parsed tokens (white/critical 5.0:1, critical/black 4.0:1, both over the AA large-text 3.0 floor). ch.3: asserted as luminance+max-channel lower than BOTH brand reds (deeper+darker) and 'no warm bias' as G==B (an orange shift lifts green above blue) + >=40deg hue separation from amber WATCH; the pulse darkens toward black, never toward a warmer hue. WATCH/MINOR untouched + pinned. ch.4 (the behavioural half): carousel.js brightnessLevel now SHORT-CIRCUITS `if (alarmActive) return STOP_ALARM_LEVEL` (1.0, named constant) BEFORE any ambient math -- a live STOP overrides the curve, the 0.70 honest fallback AND the 0.40 alarmFloorLevel, so a dead/stale light sensor cannot dim the alarm; brightnessAlarmActive stays STOP-only so US-483-b ambient dimming is unchanged (pinned by a test). CROSS-FILE CATCH AGAIN: the token name lives in JS as DATA -- TAKEOVER_STYLE.stop.colorVar was '--red'; a CSS-only repoint leaves the STOP tier bound to brand red with no error (same shape as US-484-a's --ok-green trap). Repointed it + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py. NEW GUARD tests/ui/test_dashboard_stop_tier_safety.py (29 tests) PARSES both CSS files and COMPUTES luminance/contrast/hue from the token values, so drift in EITHER file re-reds -- a hardcoded expected-hex would not. Replaced US-484-a's deliberate scope-fence test (which asserted STOP was STILL on brand red) with the reconciled assertion; updated the 3 US-483-b alarm-floor tests to the ch.4 contract. GREEN in-loop: tests/ui/ + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py = 148 passed; ruff clean on 4 touched py files. GATES for PM: black+mypy not installed on the Windows host (standing gap); no config change so validate_config.py N/A. PI-RUNTIME GATE OWED (story validationCriteria, not reproducible off-Pi): trigger a real STOP takeover on the panel -- full-bleed near-black + pulsing + 'PULL OVER', FULL brightness with the cabin dark, and STOP/WATCH/MINOR still reading in severity order. FILED TD-066 (alarmFloorLevel is now UNREACHABLE -- its only consumer condition returns full; left resolvable so a deployed config.json still parses, but remove-vs-repurpose 'does WATCH want a floor?' is a Spool call), TD-067 (10 NON-STOP surfaces still paint brand --red-light though tokens.css reserves brand reds for the brand mark -- .detail-directive and #clear-confirm-ok are the two that now read inconsistent with this repoint; needs a Spool severity call + possibly a Rule-10 token), and an issue for Atlas (tokens.css:87-94 still calls the STOP repoint the 'KNOWN-open half' -- stale; specs/ is read-only for Ralph so it is a request). Committed 8ae7100. SPRINT COMPLETE -- emitted <promise>COMPLETE</promise>. PRIOR THIS SPRINT: US-484-a DONE (passes:true) -- SSOT token reconciliation, the mechanical half of the split US-484. BL-024 IS FULLY RESOLVED: both gated values landed before this iteration (--text-primary #DDDDDD tokens.css:28, Atlas 2026-07-25; --critical-red #D32F2F tokens.css:69, Atlas 2026-07-26 commit 2a64549). AC1: renamed the forked dist token --ok-green #2ECC71 -> SSOT --green-ok #35C46A (name AND value, tokens.css:43/Atlas A-8) + repointed all 9 var() consumers. CROSS-FILE CATCH (the non-obvious half): carousel.js holds token NAMES as DATA -- TAKEOVER_STYLE.minor.colorVar was '--ok-green', so a CSS-only rename would have left the MINOR takeover binding a var that no longer resolves (silently unstyled tier, no error). Repointed it + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py:847. AC2: dashboard.css:16 was ALREADY #DDDDDD -- it matched the value Atlas subsequently blessed, so verify-and-pin not edit; added SSOT file:line provenance across the neutral/amber tier. AC3: a name-only grep MISSES the rgba() spelling -- .dtc-trust-badge[verified] carried rgba(46,204,113,0.18) = #2ECC71 at 18% alpha -> rgba(53,196,106,0.18). Repo grep now zero for --ok-green / 2ECC71 / rgba(46,204,113) outside the guard test's own assertions. AC4 SCOPE FENCE HELD: STOP tier untouched; a test asserts #dtc-ribbon[stop] + .dtc-chip[stop] are STILL on brand --red-light AND that --critical-red does NOT yet appear in dashboard.css -- so this slice cannot half-land the safety repoint US-484-b must ship as ONE coherent change (hex alone is the weakest channel per Spool 6d). DURABLE HALF: new tests/ui/test_dashboard_token_ssot.py (11 tests) PARSES BOTH files and compares declarations, so drift in EITHER file re-reds (asserting a literal in dashboard.css alone would pass forever even after an SSOT edit); also pins text-secondary/tertiary/amber-warn so the neutral ramp cannot quietly re-fork. GREEN in-loop: 11 new pass; tests/ui/ + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py = 119 passed; ruff clean on both touched py files. GATES for PM/integration: black + mypy NOT installed on the Windows dev host (standing gap). VISUAL no-regression = PI-RUNTIME/DEPLOY gate -- the green does shift #2ECC71 -> #35C46A (slightly deeper/less mint); that IS the intended SSOT value, not a regression, but the CIO should eyeball the ok-glyph/tiles/MINOR chip on the panel at deploy. Filed TD-065: residual untokenized literals -- (a) two .dtc-chip #2a2f37 that already duplicate SSOT --neutral-chip-bg (mechanical, needs no gate) and (b) --bg/--surface + takeover gradient edges with NO SSOT counterpart, which need an Atlas Rule-10 call on whether the SSOT tokenizes derived/darkened shades at all; refused to invent those tokens (that is the exact drift this story removes). Committed 39a33e6. NEXT AVAILABLE: US-484-b (DTC STOP-tier SAFETY treatment, M) -- NOW UNBLOCKED, --critical-red #D32F2F is in the SSOT; it is the ONLY remaining passes:false story. Repoint against the token, never a hardcoded hex, and carry STOP by area+motion+text+near-black+full-brightness (Spool offices/tuner/dtc-display-clear-safety-advisory.md 6d), with colour as the THIRD reinforcement. Emitted NO tag (single-agent mode, work remains).
